notes.title: Steam Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hi Travelers,

You may have seen on our social media pages that our release of Andromeda Six Early Access here on Steam has been delayed while we address some issues we're facing with our build. Today we're here to just give you another quick update that we're waiting on the go ahead from the Steam team, and will be releasing as soon as we can.

To avoid further disappointment we won't be giving a timeframe on when we expect the release to happen, but we are hopeful that the wait won't be long now, and we'll post another update once the release is ready to go. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time!



The Wanderlust Games Team
